title: Bharat Chain
tagline: Solving Multi-industry supply chain hurdles by leveraging the power of Blockchain and Web3 in India and Beyond!
description:
Supply chains and its efficiency define a nation's economy and well being to a large extent. It is very unlikely of one to expect any fraudlents or hiccups in the the cycle of B2B or B2C, but still it is something that prevails in any developing country. Built on L2 blockchain, various stakeholders can onboard themselves and its peers onto our platform and leverage the features and advantages being brought by Web3 infrastructure.
